$comment: Pinned PDFium release used by the Windows backend. Only Windows needs PDFium:
CUPS consumes PDF natively, so the macOS and Linux prebuilds ship nothing here.
To move to a newer PDFium: bump `tag` and `version`, replace the sha256 values
with those of the new release's assets, and re-vendor include/fpdfview.h from
the same archive so the header and the DLL cannot drift apart.
